package main import ( "database/sql" "fmt" "net/http" "time" "github.com/gin-gonic/gin" _ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3" "github.com/google/uuid" ) type Entry struct { ID string `json:"id"` Title string `json:"title"` Content string `json:"content"` LastModifiedBy string `json:"lastModifiedBy"` LastModifiedAt string `json:"lastModifiedAt"` } type NewEntry struct { Title string `json:"title" binding:"required"` Content string `json:"content" binding:"required"` CreatedBy string `json:"createdBy" binding:"required"` } type UpdateEntry struct { Content string `json:"content" binding:"required"` ModifiedBy string `json:"modifiedBy" binding:"required"` Summary string `json:"summary" binding:"required"` } func main() { r := gin.Default() db := initDB() defer db.Close() r.GET("/entries", func(c *gin.Context) { entries := getAllEntries(db) htmlContent := "

Entries

    " for _, entry := range entries { htmlContent += fmt.Sprintf("
  • %s
    • ", entry.ID, entry.Title) } htmlContent += "
" c.Data(http.StatusOK, "text/html; charset=utf-8", []byte(htmlContent)) }) r.POST("/entries", func(c *gin.Context) { var newEntry NewEntry if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&newEntry); err != nil { c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": err.Error()}) return } entry := createEntry(db, newEntry) c.JSON(http.StatusCreated, entry) }) r.GET("/entries/:entryId", func(c *gin.Context) { entryId := c.Param("entryId") entry, found := getEntry(db, entryId) if !found { c.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, gin.H{"error": "Entry not found"}) return } htmlContent := fmt.Sprintf("

%s

%s

Last modified by: %s at %s

", entry.Title, entry.Content, entry.LastModifiedBy, entry.LastModifiedAt) c.Data(http.StatusOK, "text/html; charset=utf-8", []byte(htmlContent)) }) r.PUT("/entries/:entryId", func(c *gin.Context) { entryId := c.Param("entryId") var updateEntry UpdateEntry if err := c.ShouldBindJSON(&updateEntry); err != nil { c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, gin.H{"error": err.Error()}) return } entry, updated := updateEntryContent(db, entryId, updateEntry) if !updated { c.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, gin.H{"error": "Entry not found"}) return } c.JSON(http.StatusOK, entry) }) r.GET("/entries/:entryId/edits", func(c *gin.Context) { entryId := c.Param("entryId") edits, found := getEntryEdits(db, entryId) if !found { c.JSON(http.StatusNotFound, gin.H{"error": "Entry not found"}) return } htmlContent := "

Edit History

    " for _, edit := range edits { htmlContent += fmt.Sprintf("
  • Modified by: %s at %s
    Summary: %s
    Content: %s
    • ", edit["modifiedBy"], edit["modifiedAt"], edit["summary"], edit["content"]) } htmlContent += "
" c.Data(http.StatusOK, "text/html; charset=utf-8", []byte(htmlContent)) }) r.Run("0.0.0.0:5000") } func initDB() *sql.DB { db, err := sql.Open("sqlite3", "./db.sqlite3") if err != nil { panic(err) } createEntriesTable := ` CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS entries ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, content TEXT, lastModifiedBy TEXT, lastModifiedAt TEXT ); ` _, err = db.Exec(createEntriesTable) if err != nil { panic(err) } createEditsTable := ` CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS edits ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, entryId TEXT, content TEXT, modifiedBy TEXT, summary TEXT, modifiedAt TEXT, FOREIGN KEY(entryId) REFERENCES entries(id) ); ` _, err = db.Exec(createEditsTable) if err != nil { panic(err) } return db } func getAllEntries(db *sql.DB) []Entry { rows, err := db.Query("SELECT id, title, content, lastModifiedBy, lastModifiedAt FROM entries") if err != nil { panic(err) } defer rows.Close() var entries []Entry for rows.Next() { var entry Entry rows.Scan(&entry.ID, &entry.Title, &entry.Content, &entry.LastModifiedBy, &entry.LastModifiedAt) entries = append(entries, entry) } return entries } func createEntry(db *sql.DB, newEntry NewEntry) Entry { id := uuid.New().String() now := time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339) _, err := db.Exec("INSERT INTO entries (id, title, content, lastModifiedBy, lastModifiedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", id, newEntry.Title, newEntry.Content, newEntry.CreatedBy, now) if err != nil { panic(err) } return Entry{ID: id, Title: newEntry.Title, Content: newEntry.Content, LastModifiedBy: newEntry.CreatedBy, LastModifiedAt: now} } func getEntry(db *sql.DB, entryId string) (Entry, bool) { row := db.QueryRow("SELECT id, title, content, lastModifiedBy, lastModifiedAt FROM entries WHERE id = ?", entryId) var entry Entry err := row.Scan(&entry.ID, &entry.Title, &entry.Content, &entry.LastModifiedBy, &entry.LastModifiedAt) if err == sql.ErrNoRows { return Entry{}, false } else if err != nil { panic(err) } return entry, true } func updateEntryContent(db *sql.DB, entryId string, updateEntry UpdateEntry) (Entry, bool) { now := time.Now().Format(time.RFC3339) _, err := db.Exec("UPDATE entries SET content = ?, lastModifiedBy = ?, lastModifiedAt = ? WHERE id = ?", updateEntry.Content, updateEntry.ModifiedBy, now, entryId) if err != nil { panic(err) } _, err = db.Exec("INSERT INTO edits (id, entryId, content, modifiedBy, summary, modifiedAt) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", uuid.New().String(), entryId, updateEntry.Content, updateEntry.ModifiedBy, updateEntry.Summary, now) if err != nil { panic(err) } return getEntry(db, entryId) } func getEntryEdits(db *sql.DB, entryId string) ([]map[string]string, bool) { rows, err := db.Query("SELECT content, modifiedBy, summary, modifiedAt FROM edits WHERE entryId = ?", entryId) if err != nil { panic(err) } defer rows.Close() var edits []map[string]string for rows.Next() { var content, modifiedBy, summary, modifiedAt string rows.Scan(&content, &modifiedBy, &summary, &modifiedAt) edit := map[string]string{ "content": content, "modifiedBy": modifiedBy, "summary": summary, "modifiedAt": modifiedAt, } edits = append(edits, edit) } if len(edits) == 0 { return nil, false } return edits, true }

Lastly, the discussion points out the absence of authentication and authorization mechanisms, which are critical for securing the application against unauthorized access and ensuring data protection.

In conclusion, while the solution demonstrates a solid foundation in terms of correctness, it is not completely correct and secure in every execution step. Addressing the response content type issue, enhancing input validation, improving error handling, and implementing authentication and authorization are necessary steps to achieve a perfect solution that satisfies all requirements without compromising security or causing harmful effects.
